notes: Chunk C: topics T18 to T25 (Nearest Numbers, the rabbit questions, Let Us Think, Travelling Now and Then, Let Us Do on vehicles, Finding Large Numbers).
Only the three rabbit road questions (tens, hundreds, thousands) have a printed figure that the learner needs; each gets a question road and a solution road with the jump arrows.
The book draws the rabbit mid-jump facing the nearer carrot; the question figures draw it facing front so that the figure does not give the answer.
The LP hints q_figure / s_figure of C93, C95, C97 and C101 describe figures that the book does not print; no question figure is invented.
